$comment: Single source of truth for the integration tests in test/integration/. The bump script (script/test/refresh-integration-snapshot.sh) regenerates everything below. Adding or removing a test account is a JSON edit only — see docs/howto/refresh-integration-test-blocks.md.
$tolerance_comment: Max relative drift allowed between forge-computed NAV and Debank's USD total at bump time. 0.01 = 1%.
$supportedDeBankProtocols_comment: Debank protocol id allowlist per chain. The bump script filters /v1/user/all_complex_protocol_list by (chain matches debankChainId) AND (id with chain prefix stripped ∈ list). Stored as the short id (no chain prefix) — Debank uses bare ids on mainnet and `<chain>_<id>` elsewhere; the script normalises both. Add a new entry whenever a balance adapter is added for a protocol Debank covers; if Debank doesn't cover the protocol, add nothing and accept that NAV will exceed filtered-Debank by that position's value.

1.name: mainnet
1.$untracked_by_design: Protocols and wallet/reward tokens deliberately excluded from this chain's allowlist (filtered-Debank ignores them; NAV doesn't track them). Re-evaluate when an adapter/feed becomes available. PROTOCOLS — full exclusion from the supportedDeBankProtocols allowlist: balancer2 (no Bal V2 adapter; LP positions remain dust on covered accounts); sablier (no adapter; lockups today only hold unpriceable tokens like COW); acrocc_v2 (Across V2 LP — not a karpatkey protocol of interest); multichain (defunct/exploited bridge); compound (Compound V2 — only V3 covered); layer3, espresso, ekubo (small ACCOUNT_12 reward bags in non-Karpatkey protocols). PARTIAL PROTOCOL COVERAGE — protocol IS in the allowlist but only some pools/markets are wired: convex (RLUSD/crvUSD/weETH/CRV pools are wired; the cvxFXS pool ACCOUNT_12 holds is not); stakewise (V3 OsToken + Genesis Vault + MetaVault are wired; legacy V2 Rewards and Staked contracts surfaced by Debank — obsolete, no new deposits — are not); uniswap3 (most observed pools are wired or disabled, but the WETH/COW pool is intentionally disabled because COW is unpriceable). WALLET / REWARD TOKENS without a Chainlink mainnet price feed: COW, HEX, POL (Polygon-only feed), CASHW (spam), AEVO, GEAR (Gearbox token; appears as a Merkl reward), MORPHO (Base-only feed; appears as Merkl reward and as a Balancer V3 LP component), sETH2 (StakeWise V2 legacy LST; appears in Uni V3 ETH/sETH2 LPs), EKUBO. COW-containing UniV3/PancakeSwap pools are disabled in chains/1.json.balanceAdapters since their COW leg can't be valued.

accounts.$comment: Mainnet diversified holder (~$23.6M Debank). Primary purpose: exercise the new UniswapV3 adapter dispatch via the WETH/COW 0.3% LP NFT (~$555K) added to chain 1 config. Other Mainnet positions (Morpho ~$5.75M, Lido stETH ~$2.13M, USDC wallet ~$9.66M) are already covered by existing harness adapters. The small ~$560 StakeWise osETH position is covered as a Custom-priced ERC20 (osToken_PriceOracle / priceFeeds.osETH) reported by ERC20DefaultOracle. Known structural drift vs Debank-filtered: COW token ($4M wallet + ~$278K Uni V3 leg) is unpriced on Mainnet — register a custom COW feed in a follow-up to reduce drift. Sablier ($1.5M COW deposit) is still unaccounted by NAV (no Sablier adapter); excluded from supportedDeBankProtocols allowlist for chain 1 so filtered Debank stays consistent.
accounts.label: ACCOUNT_9_MAINNET_DIVERSIFIED

accounts.$comment: Mainnet LST/yield holder (~$96M Debank). Exercises a broad slice of the existing harness via wallet receipt tokens valued through ERC20DefaultOracle: sUSDS (~$29.6M Sky savings), ETHx (~$24.5M Stader LST), rETH (~$4.14M RocketPool), MORPHO rewards, plus the Merkl proof-cached adapter. The bulk ~$24.6M StakeWise V3 position lives in the Genesis Vault and is now covered once StakeWiseV3Vault_Genesis is deployed and registered (returns net `vaultAssets - mintedOs` denominated in ETH-sentinel; see StakeWise V3 wiring in NAV_V2_DEPLOYMENT_RUNBOOK.md). No osETH price feed is required since the balance oracles report ETH-denominated positions.
